provenance: Current exported interview/state functions in a fresh isolated Node process; at most three user turns. No local server, UI, Realtime or microphone interaction.

messages.text: Can you help me check whether a shop has an item in stock?
Sure, I can help with that. Could you please tell me the item you're looking for and the name or location of the shop?

This is a fictional shop-call simulation. I am looking for a navy waterproof daypack with a capacity of about 20 litres. I do not have a particular brand in mind; any bag matching those specifications is fine. I am looking in Mapo, Seoul, and would like to pick it up this evening. Please check whether the matching item is currently in stock, its price, and the shop closing time or latest pickup time this evening.

A simulation plan is ready to check for a navy waterproof daypack (about 20 litres, any brand) in Mapo, Seoul, for pickup this evening. Details for local shops are fictional and unconfirmed. May I proceed to simulate calling the listed stores to check current stock, price, and closing time or latest pickup time?

requiredQuestions.text: Do you currently have a navy waterproof daypack with a capacity of about 20 litres in stock, regardless of brand, for pickup this evening?
requiredQuestions.korean: 오늘 저녁에 픽업할 수 있는 네이비 방수 데이팩(약 20리터 용량, 브랜드 무관)이 재고로 있나요?

requiredQuestions.text: What is the price of the available navy waterproof daypack (about 20 litres)?
requiredQuestions.korean: 구매 가능한 네이비 방수 데이팩(약 20리터 용량)의 가격이 얼마인가요?

requiredQuestions.text: What is your closing time or latest possible pickup time this evening?
requiredQuestions.korean: 오늘 저녁 매장 마감 시간이나 가장 늦게 픽업할 수 있는 시간이 언제인가요?

violations.quote: To assist you best, could you please confirm if you have any budget constraints or price range for the navy waterproof daypack? Also, do you prefer a particular type of waterproof material or any additional features like laptop compartments or extra pockets?
violations.explanation: The customer has already provided actionable information about the desired item (navy waterproof daypack, about 20 litres, any brand), location (Mapo, Seoul), and timeframe (this evening), as well as checkable constraints (stock, price, shop closing/pickup time). The response should prepare a call plan or clarify permission to proceed, not simply solicit additional constraints when the scenario is ready.
